newEntriesNeeded.title: PML RELOAD OBJECT command
newEntriesNeeded.principle: PML RELOAD OBJECT reloads a previously compiled PML object into the current session, ensuring the latest definition is active.
newEntriesNeeded.rule: Use PML RELOAD OBJECT <ObjectName> to reload an object after its source has been modified. The object must already exist in the session.
newEntriesNeeded.exampleCanonical:
-- Reload TAGMANAGEMENTTMP before using it
PML RELOAD OBJECT TAGMANAGEMENTTMP
!tagMgmt = object TAGMANAGEMENTTMP()
!tagMgmt.deleteUnnamedTags()
pitfalls: Reloading a non-existent object will cause a runtime error
Reloaded objects replace the previous instance in memory — existing references may become stale
newEntriesNeeded.sourcedoc: AVEVA PML Customization Guide — Macros section

newEntriesNeeded.title: TAGMANAGEMENTTMP customer object
newEntriesNeeded.principle: TAGMANAGEMENTTMP is a project-specific PML object providing tag management utilities including deletion of unnamed tags.
newEntriesNeeded.rule: Construct with object TAGMANAGEMENTTMP() and call deleteUnnamedTags() to remove unnamed tags from the current database context.
newEntriesNeeded.exampleCanonical:
PML RELOAD OBJECT TAGMANAGEMENTTMP
!tagMgmt = object TAGMANAGEMENTTMP()
!tagMgmt.deleteUnnamedTags()
pitfalls: Object must be reloaded after source changes
deleteUnnamedTags() operates on the current database session context
